rules.label: Conventions enforced
rules.heading: Rules for consistent code
rules.commit: Enforces conventional commit format (feat/fix/chore) with emoji prefix, keeping history scannable and compatible with changelog automation.
rules.versioning: Automates semver bumps and CHANGELOG.md entries based on commit types. Run release.mjs after each push to tag and publish the new version.
rules.vueCode: Vue 3 Composition API style guide — single-file component structure, template conventions, component naming, and prop/emit patterns.
rules.ts: TypeScript rules for Composition API — script setup, typed props and emits, no implicit any, and consistent import style.
rules.pinia: Pinia store conventions — setup-style defineStore, useXxxStore naming, and no direct store-to-store wiring inside components.
rules.scss: SCSS coding conventions — BEM-inspired class names, design token usage, no magic numbers, no deep selectors in scoped styles.
rules.clientApi: Typed API client conventions — service modules, axios wrapper usage, and consistent error normalisation across all requests.
rules.documentation: JSDoc and component documentation rules — props, events, and slot docs in the Vue Styleguidist-compatible format.
rules.zod: Zod usage patterns — environment variable validation through a typed gateway, schema naming, and parse vs safeParse guidance.
rules.vueRouter: Vue Router conventions — lazy-loaded routes, file-based naming, Composition API navigation, and data fetching patterns.
rules.i18n: Internationalisation conventions — key naming (nested dot-notation), useI18n Composition API usage, locale file structure, and no hardcoded UI strings.
